preserve_fields.name: Paid-included credit terminal-recipient compensation
preserve_fields.title: Paid-included credit terminal-recipient compensation
preserve_fields.purpose: Prove that a real Shopify recovery committed against paid included capacity is corrected exactly once by a signed Meta FAILED/131026 callback, without affecting another credit source.
preconditions: Real local Shopify and Messaging ingress, production Background recovery, Shopify-event and Messaging workers
Synthetic Shopify consent and approved Marketing template bindings only; no live providers
fixtures: One active Shopify Shop with exactly one source-specific credit and zero lifetime-Free capacity
One genuine Shopify checkout / active opted-in synthetic recipient
One Meta-approved test template and local signed status webhook
actions: Create source entitlement/grant/lot without pre-inserting a UsageReservation or UsageEvent
POST signed Shopify checkout and wait for the production recovery worker to commit the chosen source
POST signed Meta FAILED/131026 for the exact provider message and wait for compensation and suppression
Replay FAILED and send stale SENT; assert financial, reachability and merchant notice idempotency
assertions: Initial COMMITTED reservation and original positive UsageEvent belong to the intended source, Shop and exact attempt
A single linked negative correction restores spendable entitlement and deletes the exact outbound automated hard-limit usage
No fallback to lifetime-Free and no changes to another source; Shop-scoped seven-day suppression and one post-correction merchant notice
Duplicate FAILED and stale SENT do not create another credit correction, notice or provider send
evidence: Production worker execution and provider-emulator acceptance of one template
Exact reservation/positive and negative UsageEvent IDs and source-owned counter/lot values
Shop-scoped recipient reachability and timestamp-ordered SYSTEM notice rows
cleanup: Stop local workers, ingresses and emulated providers
